$comment: Built on SIP — Starlight Model Arena run receipt. Schema: arena-run v0.2. Round 3 = full Anthropic lineup, model lane of the Proving Ground.
card: round-3-lineup: full Anthropic lineup (Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5), 4 tasks, fully mechanical verification — zero LLM-judge dependence

tasks.category: coding — leftmost-longest edge case, self-verifying asserts
tasks.verification: agent ran `python solution.py`; ALL PASS required; leftmost-tie asserts pin the gotcha
tasks.winner: tie (4-way) — saturated; all four used expand-around-center with strict-greater tie-keeping

tasks.verification: python check: 4 keys, verdict enum, summary EXACTLY 16 words + contains 'lane' + excludes 'score', 3 kebab tags, exact date

tasks.category: grounding — the honest answer is 'not stated' (0.20 is real but NOT in the given passage)
tasks.verification: string check: acknowledges absence vs fabricates a specific precision value

haiku.note: correct but verbose — multi-sentence despite 'output only your answer'

tasks.category: exactly 5 words, lowercase, no punctuation — script-verified
tasks.winner: fable / sonnet / haiku on format; opus overshot

summary.headline: Capability is saturated across the ENTIRE Anthropic lineup — the coding edge case and hallucination-resistance were passed by all four, Haiku included. The only axis that separated the models was output-constraint discipline, where the ranking is Fable >> Sonnet/Haiku > Opus. Opus 4.8 placed last on this card purely by leaking past output constraints (dropped a JSON key, 'scorecard' tripped the 'no score' rule, 6 words where 5 were asked) — the same signature flaw seen in R1 and R2.
routingImplications: Coding + grounding/hallucination task classes: route to HAIKU — it matched Opus at a fraction of the cost. Paying for Opus there buys nothing.
Constrained-output pipeline work (JSON schemas, word caps, strict format): route to FABLE. Do NOT route to Opus — it is the lineup's weakest at output discipline across three rounds.
Opus's strength (deep multi-step reasoning, long-context synthesis, rich prose) is NOT exercised by this card — see weakness.
summary.weakness: This card is biased toward constraint-discipline and contains NO hard-reasoning or long-context-synthesis task where Opus 4.8's ceiling would show. It measures COMPLIANCE, not CAPABILITY CEILING. A fair lineup verdict requires a future round with a deep-reasoning lane (multi-step proof, long-context contradiction detection) before concluding Opus is 'worst' — it is worst *at output discipline*, which is a different claim. n=1 per task; directional.
caveats: n=1 per task — directional, not statistical.
Zero LLM-judge dependence: every result mechanically verified or string-checked.
Card composition favors compliance over reasoning ceiling (see weakness).
